integrity: All symbolic cases are proved; an additional standalone Python verifier was executed. No claim of independent external scientific validation is made.
scientific_limitations: Proves the exact Frobenius number, genus and symmetry only for gcd-normalized triples of consecutive tetrahedral numbers n>=2. Classical gluing identities are used. Finite regression checks n=2..140 but is not an infinite proof; direct three-term literature coverage is not definitively excluded.
title: Six-phase Frobenius law and symmetry for normalized consecutive tetrahedral triples
